svg.text: Assembly guide · board 52 × 90 mm · back side
BACK SIDE, seen from behind (flip the board like a book page, so left and right are swapped). Parts on this side: surface-mount parts,
ESP32 socket, battery connector, power switch, electrolytic capacitor. Through-hole parts mounted on the back are inserted from this side
41 resistors, NOT polarised. Values are printed in the figure; the markings on the parts are very small, so sort them into
bags by value or check with a multimeter.
5 ceramic capacitors, NOT polarised (22 µF in 1210 size, 100 nF in 0805 size).
Tantalum capacitor C_GATE 4.7 µF: polarised. Yellow band on the body = POSITIVE (+) end; solder toward the + mark.
Diodes: white band on the body = cathode (K), solder toward the K mark. DWAKE0–3 are 1N4148W, DBOOST is SS34 (large, SMC
AO3401A (P-MOSFET), 3 parts: QDIG1, QDIG2, QPWR. Pins G/S/D are marked on the pads.
MMBT3904 (NPN), 6 parts: QHOLD, QROW0, QROW1, QROW2, QROW3, QWAKE. Pins B/E/C are marked on the pads.
BSS138 (N-MOSFET), 4 parts: QCOL0, QCOL1, QCOL2, QCOL3. Pins G/S/D are marked on the pads. The three SOT-23 types look
identical, so keep them in separate bags.
ICs (U1 MT3608, U2 74HC595): pink dot = pin 1; match it to the dot or notch on the IC body.
Two female header rows for the ESP32 module (J1, J2). Pink dot = pin 1 (the module's USB end) and pin 15 (the antenna end).
Battery connector JBAT: + (red wire from the battery holder) and − (black wire). Reversed polarity can damage the circuit.
Electrolytic capacitor CRES 470 µF 16 V: polarised. White stripe on the body = NEGATIVE (−) pin. Longer leg = positive (+).
Suggested soldering order: 1) resistors, ceramic capacitors 2) diodes, transistors 3) ICs, inductor, 22 µF capacitors 4)
Small grey dots and small empty circles are test pads; leave them empty. The dashed ring around each screw hole marks an area with
